hops.note: Single hop: baseline.json migration_path.on_preparation_line is true (3.5.x).

deterministic_candidates.notes: Pinned to the requested 4.1.1 / Java 21. Preview first; reject anything outside the impact list, in particular removal of @JsonFormat from ErrorResponse (pack notes: changes the serialized error timestamp), Testcontainers version changes, and any change under .github/ or docs/.

residual_candidates.why_not_deterministic: No recipe in the pack changes a Dockerfile base image (section 15).
UpgradeJavaVersion may not normalise the explicit maven-compiler-plugin <source>/<target>; fixed by hand only if the preview or a round shows it stayed at 17.
A hand-built mapper bean whose configuration API changed shape may be beyond the recipe (section 15); fixed only if a round names it.
Hibernate 7 query parsing issues surface only in tests or at runtime; nothing to change unless they fail.
Lambda DSL expected to compile unchanged; only a Security 7 compile error would justify an edit.

out_of_scope: Fixing the two pre-existing EmployeeControllerTest actuator slice failures (404 in @WebMvcTest)
Testcontainers 2 migration or any Testcontainers version change
Removing @JsonFormat from ErrorResponse (would change the error-contract timestamp format)
Business bug: EmployeeService checks duplicate email via findByEmployeeNumber(request.getEmail())
Changing the PostgreSQL driver scope or the default datasource
H2 console / frame-options security rules, formatting, import reordering, refactors
Widening @WebMvcTest to @SpringBootTest unless a build proves the slice cannot work
stop_conditions: Round on JDK 21 cannot compile at release 21 for a reason outside the pack (C3)
A business or security-boundary probe changes status and the cause is not within the migration's scope
A package round shows a new test failure that cannot be traced to a pack rule
The only available transformation output would require accepting out-of-scope changes
unresolved_questions: Whether the curated recipe rewrites the hand-built Jackson 2 ObjectMapper bean into a Jackson 3 form that keeps the exact serialization (ISO LocalDateTime, NON_NULL)
Whether H2 in the Boot 4.1.1 BOM can open the H2 2.3.232 file database the baseline run created in the sandbox
